summary: Multiline field for AI prompts, with keyboard submit, generating state and a stop action. No networking or model dependencies.
whenToUse: Composing prompts in assistants and writing tools.
Connecting a frontend to an AI service managed by the consumer.
whenNotToUse: Authenticating requests or storing API keys in the browser.

props.name: onSend
props.description: Receives the text with leading/trailing whitespace trimmed. Does not clear the field.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: Controlled value or uncontrolled initial value.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Text changes, including spaces and newlines.

props.name: isGenerating
props.description: Prevents duplicate submissions; the text stays editable.

props.name: onStop
props.description: Shows the stop button while generating. The consumer must cancel the request.

props.name: label / placeholder
props.description: Localized defaults. Use a visible, contextual label.

props.name: footer
props.description: Notes, estimated cost or integration status.

props.name: textareaProps
props.description: Textarea attributes and events; onKeyDown runs before the shortcut and can prevent it.

props.name: isInvalid / minLength / maxLength
props.description: An explicit error or a trimmed text length out of bounds prevents submission.

inherits: Textarea props: label, description, errorMessage, isDisabled, isReadOnly, isInvalid, maxLength, rows, name, className and style. Ref to the textarea.

keyboard.action: Submits when the text is not empty and the control is enabled.

accessibility: Label and descriptions are associated by Textarea.
The button stays keyboard-reachable and has localized text.
responsive: Textarea and actions follow the container; footer and buttons wrap.
customization: Semantic tokens for surface, border, spacing and radii.
className/style apply to the field; textareaProps to the native control.
commonMistakes: Forgetting to handle errors and cancellation in the consumer.
Clearing the field without keeping the prompt when a request fails.

examples.name: AssistantWorkspace
examples.title: Full assistant with local response
examples.description: Suggestions, messages, sources and feedback; no AI model connected.

limits: No AI client, uploads, persistence or token management.
The consumer validates content and permissions and handles async errors.
The component does not automatically manage conversation scrolling.
